lines.text: Many learners say: I have seen him yesterday.
With yesterday, use the simple past.

data.why: With yesterday, use the simple past.

native.hook: yesterday に現在完了は使えない
native.tip: 「昨日」など過去の時を言うなら、過去形 saw を使います。
native.caption: “I have seen him yesterday.”と言っていませんか？😅 yesterday のように過去の時がはっきりしているときは、現在完了ではなく過去形を使います。 “I saw him yesterday.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“saw”。yesterday には過去形。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: With a clear past time like yesterday, use the simple past.
en.caption: Do you say “I have seen him yesterday.”? 😅 With a clear past time such as yesterday, use the simple past, not the present perfect. The natural way is “I saw him yesterday.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
